#{IV_NO}

SELECT /** selectMasterWmGrStockGrCreForUpdateList */ PO.BUYER BUYER, PO.SELLER SELLER , PO.PO_NO PO_NO, PO.PO_SEQ PO_SEQ, IV.INV_NO INV_NO, IV.INV_SEQ INV_SEQ, #{st_user_id}, PR.AGENT AGENT, PO.AGENT_PRICE AGENT_PRICE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') GR_DATE, IV.INV_QTY INV_QTY FROM ICOMPODT PO, ICOMIVDT IV , ICOMPRDT PR WHERE PO.BUYER = IV.BUYER AND PO.PO_NO = IV.PO_NO AND PO.PO_SEQ = IV.PO_SEQ AND PO.PR_NO = PR.PR_NO AND PO.PR_SEQ = PR.PR_SEQ AND PO.BUYER = PR.BUYER AND IV.BUYER = #{st_warehouse_code} AND PO.STATUS <> 'D' AND IV.STATUS <> 'D' AND PR.STATUS <> 'D' AND IV.INV_NO = #{IV_NO}
Select /** selectOrderNo */ doc_type||SUBSTR(year,3,2)||LPAD(cur_no,6,0) GRNO FROM ICOMSQMT WHERE company=#{st_warehouse_code} and doc_type='GR'
mapper.update: UPDATE /** insertIcomsqmt */ icomsqmt SET year = decode(year,to_char(sysdate,'yyyy'), year,to_char(sysdate,'yyyy')) , cur_no = decode(year,to_char(sysdate,'yyyy'),cur_no+1,1) WHERE company =#{st_warehouse_code} and doc_type='GR'

INSERT /*insertICOMGRDT */ INTO ICOMGRDT(BUYER, GR_NO, GR_SEQ, STATUS, SEND_DATE, SEND_TIME, ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_TIME, CONFIRM_DATE, CONFIRM_TIME, SELLER, GR_DATE, PAY_TERMS, USANCE_DAYS, BUYER_ITEM_NO, SELLER_ITEM_NO, DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION, CUR, UNIT_MEASURE, ITEM_QTY, UNIT_PRICE, ITEM_AMT, INV_NO, INV_SEQ, PO_NO, PO_SEQ, DO_NO, DO_SEQ, EXCHANGE_RATE, GR_LOC_AMT, LC_NO, AP_NO, PROCESS_TYPE, RO_QTY, ADD_USER_ID, NOTIFY, PAYER, PAYEE, GR_BAL_QTY, AGENT, AGENT_PRICE , CHANGE_USER_ID, AGENT_ITEM_AMT) (SELECT D.BUYER, #{GRNO}, TO_CHAR(#{GR_SEQ},'FM000000'), 'C', ' ', ' ', TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS'), ' ', ' ', D.SELLER, #{GR_DATE}, H.PAY_TERMS, H.USANCE_DAYS, D.BUYER_ITEM_NO, D.SELLER_ITEM_NO, D.DESCRIPTION, D.SPECIFICATION, H.CUR, D.UNIT_MEASURE, ${INV_QTY}, T.UNIT_PRICE, TRUNC(${INV_QTY} * T.UNIT_PRICE), D.INV_NO, D.INV_SEQ, D.PO_NO, D.PO_SEQ, D.DO_NO, D.DO_SEQ, '12', '1', D.LC_NO, '', H.INV_TYPE, 0, #{st_user_id}, D.NOTIFY, D.PAYER, D.PAYEE, ${INV_QTY}, #{AGENT}, T.AGENT_PRICE ,#{st_user_id} ,TRUNC(${INV_QTY} * T.AGENT_PRICE) FROM ICOMIVDT D, ICOMIVHD H ,ICOMPODT T WHERE D.BUYER = #{BUYER} AND D.SELLER = #{SELLER} AND D.INV_NO = #{INV_NO} AND D.INV_SEQ = #{INV_SEQ} AND D.STATUS != 'D' AND D.BUYER = H.BUYER AND D.SELLER = H.SELLER AND D.INV_NO = H.INV_NO AND D.BUYER = T.BUYER AND D.PO_NO = T.PO_NO AND D.PO_SEQ = T.PO_SEQ AND H.STATUS != 'D')

UPDATE /** insertICOMPODT */ ICOMPODT SET GR_QTY = NVL(GR_QTY,0) + ${INV_QTY}, DI_QTY = NVL(DI_QTY,0) + ${INV_QTY} WHERE BUYER = #{BUYER} AND SELLER = #{SELLER} AND PO_NO =#{ PO_NO } AND PO_SEQ = #{PO_SEQ} AND STATUS != 'D' AND ITEM_QTY >= NVL(GR_QTY,0) + #{INV_QTY}

UPDATE /** insertICOMPODT */ ICOMIVDT A SET A.GR_QTY = DECODE( (SELECT B.PROCESS_TYPE FROM ICOMPODT B WHERE B.BUYER = A.BUYER AND B.PO_NO = A.PO_NO AND B.PO_SEQ = A.PO_SEQ AND B.STATUS <> 'D'),'2',NVL(A.GR_QTY,0), NVL(A.GR_QTY,0) + ${INV_QTY}) WHERE A.BUYER = #{BUYER} AND A.SELLER =#{SELLER} AND A.INV_NO = #{INV_NO} AND A.INV_SEQ = #{INV_SEQ} AND A.STATUS != 'D'
UPDATE /** updataeICOMIVHD */ ICOMIVHD SET GR_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') WHERE BUYER = #{BUYER} AND SELLER = #{SELLER} AND INV_NO = #{INV_NO} AND STATUS != 'D'

UPDATE /** updataeICOMIVDTList */ ICOMIVDT IVDT SET IVDT.WMS_GR_QTY = NVL(IVDT.INV_QTY,0), IVDT.WMS_GR_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), IVDT.WMS_GR_USER_ID = #{st_user_id} WHERE IVDT.INV_NO = #{IV_NO} AND IVDT.BUYER = #{BUYER} AND IVDT.PO_NO = #{PO_NO} AND IVDT.STATUS <> 'D'
mapper.select: SELECT /** selectICOMIVDT */ BUYER, INV_NO, INV_SEQ, BUYER_ITEM_NO, INV_QTY, UNIT_PRICE, (SELECT AGENT FROM ICOMPOHD WHERE PO_NO = IV.PO_NO AND BUYER = IV.BUYER) AGENT, (SELECT CONTRACT_NO FROM ICOMPODT WHERE PO_NO = IV.PO_NO AND BUYER = IV.BUYER AND PO_SEQ = IV.PO_SEQ) CONTRACT_NO, (SELECT CONTRACT_SEQ FROM ICOMPODT WHERE PO_NO = IV.PO_NO AND BUYER = IV.BUYER AND PO_SEQ = IV.PO_SEQ) CONTRACT_SEQ FROM ICOMIVDT IV WHERE BUYER = #{st_warehouse_code} AND INV_NO = #{IV_NO} AND IV.STATUS <> 'D'
mapper.update: UPDATE /**updataeICOMIVDTList2 */ WMSSTCK SET TOT_QTY = TOT_QTY+${INV_QTY}, AVAIL_QTY = AVAIL_QTY+${INV_QTY}, PRE_GR_QTY = PRE_GR_QTY-(${INV_QTY}), LAST_REC_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), STC_SELLER_PRICE = ROUND(DECODE(NVL(AVAIL_QTY,0)+${INV_QTY},0,0,((NVL(STC_SELLER_PRICE,0)*NVL(AVAIL_QTY,0))+(${INV_QTY}*${UNIT_PRICE}))/(NVL(AVAIL_QTY,0)+${INV_QTY})),0) , LAST_AGENT = #{AGENT} WHERE WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{BUYER} AND STDCATLG_ID = #{BUYER_ITEM_NO} AND AGENT = 'KRKORE0001'
